description: v1.0.0 (2026-09-17). Written when a research brief reaches TERMINAL_FAILURE and a human approves quarantine. Preserves the full failure evidence so the brief can be diagnosed, fixed, and reconsidered without losing history. The research contract (validate-research-contract.py) remains the pass/fail gate; this record only documents terminal failure.

approved_by.description: Who approved the quarantine (human gate; never automatic).

artifacts_preserved.description: Absolute paths of every preserved artifact (answers, reports, sidecars, jobs).

attempts.description: Every failed attempt preserved, oldest first.

failure_signature.description: Compact deterministic signature of the failure mode for dedupe across attempts.

last_successful_version.description: The most recent run of this brief that passed, so a fix can diff against what worked. Null if it never passed.

notes.description: Data-quality notes, contradictions preserved, anything a future fixer must know.

next_retry_eligible_at.description: Earliest time the brief may be reconsidered. Eligibility is NOT auto-lift.

reason.description: contract_defect means the contract itself is suspected wrong; it does NOT lower the bar, it flags the contract for human review.

retry_budget.description: Consecutive-failure limit that marked the brief TERMINAL_FAILURE before quarantine.

title: Meta AI research brief quarantine record
